description:
Weighted results for one Male Confidence Index 2025 question, optionally split by a demographic.

    Returns weighted percentages (single choice and multi-select) or weighted means (numeric), with the
    unweighted n for each cell. Cells under 30 respondents return suppressed: true.

    Args:
        question_id: e.g. "Q15", "Q11" (multi-select group), "F9", "D9". See mci_questions.
        by: optional split, e.g. "age_group", "state", "income", "gender", "employment", or any single-choice id.
        gender: optional "men", "women" or "all" (default: whoever answered the question).
        filter: optional {variable: value} to restrict the base, e.g. {"age_group": "18-28"} or
            {"S2_age": "30-39"}; use "a|b" for several values.
name: mci_results
title: Male Confidence Index: results
